content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Atlanta

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: The PMP® requires a secondary degree plus documented project-management experience, or an associate degree with additional experience hours. Review PMI's current eligibility criteria to confirm you meet the education and work-experience thresholds before enrolling in Granite PM Academy's bootcamp.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Instruction
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP Bootcamp. Over several days, you'll study the PMBOK® Guide, exam domains, and real-world scenarios. Attend all sessions synchronously from anywhere—our nationwide format fits Atlanta professionals' schedules without requiring travel or in-person attendance.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After course completion, submit your PMP application directly to PMI, documenting your education and project-management experience. Pay PMI's exam fee at that time. Granite PM Academy provides guidance on the application process to ensure accuracy and timely submission.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources, including practice tests and focused review sessions, to solidify your knowledge. Schedule your exam with Pearson VUE, then take the PMP® test at a local testing center or via remote proctoring—you choose the format that works best.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP® Credential
steps_items.text: After passing, earn Professional Development Units (PDUs) over a three-year renewal cycle through training, certifications, volunteering, or work experience. Granite PM Academy offers ongoing education and PDU-eligible courses to help you stay current and renew your credential on schedule.
